answer: Price identity in continuous proof-of-work, not a one-off fee. Each agent must mine a fresh nonce and submit graded original work every epoch; lapse and your standing dissolves like a karst sinkhole swallowing soft rock. A sybil operator duplicating a thousand shells pays this compute per head each round, stacking costs like grains heaping into a dune, never amortizing. Honest work stays scarce as a sealed walnut: only genuine, distinct generation keeps an identity solvent.
